# HowAutomate Tools
> Free browser-based productivity tools for businesses and individuals.
> Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser — files are never uploaded to a server.
> Built by HowAutomate — Data, AI & Automation agency (howautomate.com)

## Business & GST

- [Quotation Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/quotation-generator), [Proforma Invoice Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/proforma-invoice-generator), [Delivery Challan Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/delivery-challan-generator): same engine as the GST invoice (CGST/SGST/IGST, HSN, logo, bank/UPI); quotation adds a valid-until date; proforma is marked not-a-tax-invoice; challan adds reason for movement (job work, approval, stock transfer…), vehicle no., transport mode, optional value-less mode and receiver/authorised-signatory boxes.
- [UPI QR Code Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/upi-qr-code-generator): Standard UPI payment QR (upi://pay) from a UPI ID with optional fixed amount and note; works with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM; printable A6 "Scan & Pay" card. No tracking, never expires.
- [GST Invoice Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/gst-invoice-generator): Create a GST-compliant Indian tax invoice with automatic CGST/SGST vs IGST split, HSN/SAC codes, amount in words, optional bank details, optional round-off, and print/save as PDF.
- [GST Calculator](https://tools.howautomate.com/gst-calculator): Add GST to a price or remove GST from a GST-inclusive amount, with the CGST/SGST (same state) or IGST (other state) split. Covers 0.25%, 3%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%, 40% and custom rates.
- [Rent Receipt Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/rent-receipt-generator): Generate one rent receipt per month for a period (e.g. a full financial year) for an HRA claim. Warns when annual rent exceeds ₹1,00,000 (landlord PAN needed) and adds a revenue-stamp box for cash payments above ₹5,000. Prints two receipts per A4 page.
- [Salary Slip Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/salary-slip-generator): Create a standard Indian monthly payslip with editable earnings and deductions, one-click EPF (12% of Basic, ₹15,000 wage ceiling), paid/LOP days and net pay in words. Prints to PDF.

## PDF Tools

- [Organize PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/organize-pdf) ([Rotate PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/rotate-pdf), [Delete PDF pages](https://tools.howautomate.com/delete-pdf-pages)): thumbnails; reorder, rotate (per page or all) and delete pages; in the browser.
- [Add Page Numbers](https://tools.howautomate.com/add-page-numbers): six positions, formats 1 / Page 1 / 1 / N / Page 1 of N, start number, skip cover; correct on rotated pages.
- [Watermark PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/watermark-pdf): text watermark (CONFIDENTIAL, DRAFT…) once or tiled, size/angle/colour/opacity.
- [JPG to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/jpg-to-pdf) / [PNG to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/png-to-pdf): Combine photos, scans or screenshots into one PDF in the browser (never uploaded). Reorder pages, A4/Letter/Legal or image-sized pages, margins, phone rotation applied, optional size reduction.
- [PDF to JPG](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-to-jpg) / [PDF to PNG](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-to-png): Convert all or selected PDF pages to JPG or PNG at 72/150/300 DPI in the browser; multiple pages download as a ZIP.
- [Edit PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/edit-pdf): Free in-browser PDF editor. Click any line of existing text to change it: the old text is deleted from the file and the new text is written in the PDF's own embedded font when that font contains every character typed (otherwise the closest standard font). One line at a time, no paragraph re-flow; a line that can't be isolated safely is covered instead, and the user is told. Also add text, white-out, highlight, draw/type a signature and add images. The PDF is never uploaded.
- [Merge PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/merge-pdf): Combine up to 25 PDF files into one document, with drag-free reordering before download. No watermark.
- [Split PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/split-pdf): Extract chosen pages (e.g. 1-3, 7), split every page into its own file, or cut a PDF into fixed-size chunks. Multi-file results download as a ZIP.
- [Compress PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-compressor): Reduce PDF size by recompressing the images inside it while keeping text selectable, or fit an exact size: [100 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/compress-pdf-to-100kb), [200 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/compress-pdf-to-200kb), [500 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/compress-pdf-to-500kb), [1 MB](https://tools.howautomate.com/compress-pdf-to-1mb). Never returns a larger file. Runs in the browser.
- [Convert to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/pdf-converter): Convert Word ([Word to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/word-to-pdf)), Excel ([Excel to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/excel-to-pdf)), PowerPoint ([PPT to PDF](https://tools.howautomate.com/ppt-to-pdf)), images and 40+ formats to PDF, and PDF back to Word. Server-side conversion; files removed after conversion.

## Photo & Image

- [Passport Size Photo Maker](https://tools.howautomate.com/passport-size-photo): AI background removal + face detection frame a selfie as a 35×45 mm (or 2×2 inch / 25×35 mm) photo on white or light blue; single JPG with optional KB limit, or a 300-DPI 4×6 inch (8 photos) / A4 (30 photos) print sheet with cutting guides, as JPG or PDF. Runs in the browser.
- [Remove Background](https://tools.howautomate.com/remove-background): AI background removal for photos of people (MODNet, runs in the browser, ~38 MB downloaded once and cached); transparent PNG or any colour, full resolution, never uploaded.
- [Image Compressor](https://tools.howautomate.com/compress-image): Compress JPG, PNG and WebP in bulk (up to 50) with a quality slider; PNGs are palette-quantised (TinyPNG-style) and keep transparency; never returns a bigger file. In the browser.
- Image converters: [WebP to JPG](https://tools.howautomate.com/webp-to-jpg), [PNG to JPG](https://tools.howautomate.com/png-to-jpg), [JPG to PNG](https://tools.howautomate.com/jpg-to-png), [JPG to WebP](https://tools.howautomate.com/jpg-to-webp) — bulk, ZIP download, phone rotation applied, in the browser.
- [Photo Resizer in KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/photo-resizer-in-kb): Resize a photo to an exact maximum (and optional minimum) size in KB, optionally at exact pixel dimensions, for exam, job and government application forms. Finds the highest JPG quality that fits; runs in the browser, nothing uploaded. Preset pages: [10 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/resize-image-to-10kb), [20 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/resize-image-to-20kb), [50 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/resize-image-to-50kb), [100 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/resize-image-to-100kb), [200 KB](https://tools.howautomate.com/resize-image-to-200kb).
- [Signature Resizer](https://tools.howautomate.com/signature-resizer): Turn a phone photo of a signature into a clean JPG for application forms: whitens paper and shadows, darkens ink, crops to the signature and compresses to a KB range (10–20 KB by default).

## Developer

- [JSON to TypeScript & Zod](https://tools.howautomate.com/json-to-typescript-zod): Turn a JSON sample into TypeScript interfaces, Zod schemas or JSON Schema.
- [Password Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/password-generator): Generate strong random passwords with custom length, numbers and symbols.
- [DateTime / Epoch Converter](https://tools.howautomate.com/datetime-converter): Convert between human-readable dates and Unix timestamps, with a live clock.

## Everyday Utilities

- [QR Code Generator](https://tools.howautomate.com/qr-code-generator): Static QR codes (no redirect, no expiry, no tracking) for links/text, UPI, [WhatsApp chats](https://tools.howautomate.com/whatsapp-qr-code-generator), Wi-Fi and vCard contacts; custom colours with contrast warning; PNG up to 2048 px or SVG.
- [Word Counter](https://tools.howautomate.com/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, plus estimated reading time.

## Health

- [BMI Calculator](https://tools.howautomate.com/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index with health category interpretation. Supports metric and imperial units.
